critical_code_review_comments: Round-file naming in /api/native/presentations/build accepts BASENAMES only (e.g. 'MC_Alpha46_Test.bighat'), not 'TYPE/basename.bighat'. Review request payload example used 'MC/MC_Alpha46_Test.bighat' which 400s; endpoint pool-scans the type folder for basename match. Not a bug (spec says files must live in their own type folder), but consider accepting both forms for robustness or documenting explicitly in error message.

Fix 4 (Tauri dialog ACL) is static-review only — cannot be validated in container. Verified src-tauri/capabilities/default.json exists in repo; runtime behavior must be validated by main agent on packaged build.
